name: Blanchefleur

attributes.attribute: entered the domain of the wounded Fisher King
wooed by the Round Table knight Percival
known as Dindraine in some versions

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Blanchefleur is an Arthurian heroine. She is also called Blancheflor. The knight Percival entered the land of the wounded Fisher King. There he found the fair woman and asked for her hand. Her name means white flower. In some texts the name belongs to Percival's sister. That sister is otherwise known as Dindraine.

okr.objective: Describe Blanchefleur, the Arthurian heroine whom the knight Percival wooed.
key_results: The knight Perceval entered the domain of the wounded Fisher King.
Percival met and wooed the beautiful Blanchefleur.
In some texts she is the sister of Percival.
